blocks.heading: Costs Against What the First Year Pays
rows: IIT B.Tech, general category
Tuition ₹1,28,250 per semester (₹28,250 for SC, ST and PwD). Hostel and mess are extra.
₹1,28,250 × 8 semesters = about ₹10.3 lakh of tuition. Against the PayScale entry software average of ₹5.37 lakh, that is about 1.9 years of that pay, before living costs.
About ₹1 crore (₹10.3 lakh ÷ 0.10)
MBBS, government quota
Under ₹8 lakh for the whole course in the states compared
Only about 3 government seats per 100 NEET test-takers, so the fee is low and the competition is the real price.
About ₹80 lakh (₹8 lakh ÷ 0.10)
MBBS, private management quota
Above ₹60 lakh for the whole course in the states compared
At least 7.5 times the government total (₹60 lakh ÷ ₹8 lakh). The seat is easier to get and far harder to repay.

items.text: B.Tech / BE: JEE Main, JEE Advanced, state tests (Scalable with a business layer)

Keeps BCA, data, economics honours and quantitative finance open.

Fits actuarial and analytics routes better than commerce without Maths.
Still lets you register for CA Foundation, CS and CMA.

blocks.heading: Read the Chart By Your Exam Result

items.text: Use counselling to compare colleges by course, fees and placement median, not by name alone.
Budget the whole course before you accept a seat, including hostel and coaching.
Start one small skill project before college begins so first year is not empty.
Ask what your child can finish this month, not only which college name sounds safe.
Read placement claims by median and by the number placed against the full batch.
Agree on a plan B before results, so a bad paper does not become a family crisis.
Do not judge a route by the neighbour's child.

blocks.heading: Short Test to Run Before You Commit

items.text: Pick three rows from the chart.
Write the entry requirement and date for each.
Do one small task from each route.
Talk to two people inside each route.
Drop one route in writing.
